The problem

Tax time shouldn’t start with a search for receipts.

Receipts end up in email, photos and glove boxes. A 1099 you expected never arrives. You aren’t sure which dates matter, so you guess. Then January comes and you spend a weekend piecing the year together. It’s common, and it’s avoidable with one organized place to keep everything.

The solution

One toolkit. One organized year.

Everything is laid out so you can start on day one, even if you’ve never kept formal books.

Save Time

Reduce Tax Stress

Built for Freelancers

Written in plain English for 1099 workers, creators and side-hustlers.

Is it right for you?

Who it’s for, and who it’s not.

It’s for you if you

  • Earn 1099 income as a freelancer, creator or contractor
  • Want one organized place for income, expenses and documents
  • Prefer plain explanations over tax jargon
  • Hand your records to a CPA or tax preparer

It’s not for you if you

  • Want software that prepares or files your return
  • Expect tax advice or a custom tax strategy
  • Want a replacement for a CPA
  • Need payroll or full business accounting

This is a recordkeeping toolkit, not tax filing software.

FAQ

Common questions.

Is this tax advice?

No. It’s an organizational toolkit and educational guide. It doesn’t give tax, legal or accounting advice. Talk to a qualified tax professional about your situation.

Does it work in Excel and Google Sheets?

The workbook is built in Excel for Windows, Mac and mobile. You can upload it to Google Sheets, but some formatting and formulas may behave differently.

Is it beginner-friendly?

Yes. The guide uses plain English and the demo workbook shows each tab filled in with fictional data.

How do I receive it?

This is a digital product; no physical item is shipped. Follow the delivery instructions provided after purchase. Before launch, make sure your checkout and file-delivery process are configured and tested.

Is the data in the demo real?

No. Every name, figure and entry in the demo workbook and on this page is fictional and is there for illustration only.

Can I use it for tax years after 2026?

This edition is made for tax year 2026. You can reuse the layout in later years, but dates and form details change, so check them against official sources.
